New questions need different perspectives

A new kind of consulting firm.

Technology changes what an organisation can do. Working out what it should do takes research, judgement and a close understanding of the work itself.

Book a conversation

01 / HUMAN JUDGEMENT & AI

Yesterday's ways of working are becoming liabilities.

The risk is not failing to adopt AI. It is using AI to make yesterday's organisation faster.

AI creates the opportunity to rethink how work gets done — where machines act responsibly, where human judgement matters, and how the two learn together.

02 / RESEARCH & OPERATIONS

When the answer isn’t known in advance. The question shapes the work.

koralli is a research-led practice. Our teams combine researchers from Oxford with senior operators who have built and run things at scale.

The koralli model is built for uncertainty. Rigorous enough to challenge the question. Flexible enough to discover the answer.

We start with the organisation, not the technology.

Real change comes from connecting what you offer, how people work and the data they rely on.

From the boardroom to the data foundation

I / Direction and offering

What the organisation offers, who it serves and where it chooses to focus.

II / People and work

Who does the work, how teams coordinate and who is responsible for decisions.

III / Systems and tools

The applications and infrastructure people use to do the work.

IV / Data foundations

The records, definitions and checks that make information dependable.
